# EaseAbroad

EaseAbroad is a travel-guide app that helps you plan day-by-day trips with AI, discover live events during your travel dates via Ticketmaster and SeatGeek, enjoy hands-free GPS audio walking tours, and gift client itineraries as a travel agency.

## Key features

- AI day-by-day trip planner
- Live events matched to your travel dates (Ticketmaster & SeatGeek)
- Hands-free GPS audio walking tours
- Travel-agency trip gifting

## Official URLs

- Site: https://easeabroad.app/
- Web app: https://easeabroad.app/app/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.easeabroad
- Support: support@easeabroad.app
- Privacy: https://easeabroad.app/privacy/
- Terms: https://easeabroad.app/terms/
- Delete account: https://easeabroad.app/delete-account/

Available on Android and the web.
